cohort: The study included 193 women who experienced singleton stillbirths beyond 20 weeks of gestation at K.A.P. Viswanathan Government Medical College, MGMGH, Trichy, India.
finding: Foetal growth restriction was the most frequent cause of stillbirth, with anaemia, hypertension, and placental abruption identified as other significant contributing factors.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the most common mode of birth, observed in 80% of stillbirth cases.
birth_weight: 44% of stillborn infants had a birth weight below 1500 g
gest_age: Stillbirths beyond 20 weeks of gestation were included, with 72% of these occurring preterm (<37 weeks).
